map.综合得房率、方正度、面宽进深比对户型打分（满分 100）: Score a floor plan out of 100 on usable rate, regularity and the width-to-depth ratio
map.📖 查看「户型评分 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Floor Plan Score User Guide"
map.户型评分 = 综合指标加权: Floor plan score = weighted composite index
map.：得房率 80%+ 满分，每降 1% 扣 2 分: : full marks at 80%+ usable rate, minus 2 points for each 1% below
map.：面宽/进深比 0.8-1.0 最佳，偏离扣分: : best at a width/depth ratio of 0.8-1.0, with deductions for deviation
map.：南北通透满分，否则扣分: : full marks for north-south through ventilation, otherwise deducted
map.：面宽越大采光越好，按面积折算: : a wider frontage means better daylight, scaled by area
map.：3 室最优，按面积适配度评分: : three rooms is optimal, scored by fit with the area
map.看房时按得房率、方正度、通透等给户型打分。: Score a layout on usable rate, regularity and ventilation when viewing a property.
map.对比同面积不同户型的总分选优。: Compare total scores across layouts of the same size.
map.识别狭长或公摊过大等短板。: Spot weaknesses such as an elongated plan or excessive shared area.
map.建面 110㎡、套内 88㎡ → 得房率 80%（s1=40）；面宽 10、进深: Gross area 110 sqm, inner area 88 sqm gives a usable rate of 80% (s1 = 40); width 10 and depth 11 give a depth-to-width ratio of 1.1 (s2 = 22); north-south through ventilation (+15); daylight 8; three rooms is the ideal count (s5 = 10): total 95, excellent.
map.若进深面宽比>2.2（狭长），方正度仅 1 分、总分掉到 60 以下，中部暗区明: If the depth-to-width ratio exceeds 2.2 (elongated), regularity scores only 1 and the total drops below 60, with a clearly dark zone in the middle and a poor living experience.
map.得房率权重最大吗？: Does usable rate carry the largest weight?
map.得房率占 40 分（满分 100），是影响总分的最大单项，公摊小直接拉高评级。: Usable rate accounts for 40 of the 100 points and is the largest single item; a small shared area lifts the rating directly.
map.1.0–1.5 最方正，采光通风均衡；>2.2 过于狭长，中部易暗。: 1.0-1.5 is the most regular, balancing daylight and ventilation; above 2.2 is too elongated and the middle tends to be dark.
map.户型评分工具，综合得房率、方正度、通透性、采光、房间数五个维度对户型打分，直观评: The floor plan scorer rates a layout across usable rate, regularity, ventilation, daylight and room count to show its strengths and weaknesses.
